races.title: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: NO WALKOVER looked a very useful prospect in bumpers and with excuses on account of underfoot conditions when well held at Newbury on his final outing, David Pipe's charge is fancied to make a bold bid now hurdling on return. Blinded By Grace and Bob Bishop are other hurdling newcomers to note, with Jevon also commanding a check in the betting given the stable he represents. NO WALKOVER BLINDED BY GRACE BOB BISHOP

races.title: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: DIAMOND STREET displayed plenty of ability on each of his 2 starts in bumpers last season, scoring on debut at Doncaster prior to finishing a solid fifth at Newbury in March. He has plenty about him physically to suggest he will make his mark over hurdles and he earns the vote. Quickkick 's tendency to pull hard hasn't stopped steady progress to date and he's feared, with Poets Express and Moments In Time another couple of interesting types from bumpers. DIAMOND STREET (IRE) QUICKKICK (IRE) POETS EXPRESS (IRE)

races.title: Golwg Gwendraeth Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A very strong race for its type with 3 of the first 4 home from the Supreme lining up, including the winner OLD PARK STAR and runner-up Sober Glory . Both will make chasers with Old Park Star (who is currently the clear favourite for the Arkle) taken to come out on top again. OLD PARK STAR (IRE) SOBER GLORY (IRE) BARON NOIR (IRE)

races.verdict: WANNABE was set to be beaten only by a subsequent winner when departing at the last over C&D on chase bow/return so looks a big player off the same mark. Potential improvers Manhattan Valley and Walk Tall are feared most. WANNABE (IRE) MANHATTAN VALLEY (FR) WALK TALL (IRE)

races.title: Support Your Oncourse Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for MERRY AWAY , who made a successful Rules bow in a Warwick bumper back in March and enhanced his form further when fourth in Grade 2 company at the Aintree Festival next time. He can make the smooth transition to hurdling at the expense of Valiant Soldier , who promises to be suited by this step up to 2½m. Point-winner Doagh rounds off the shortlist. MERRY AWAY (IRE) VALIANT SOLDIER (IRE) DOAGH (IRE)

races.title: 3A's Leisure Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NO BOUNDARIES has way more potential than most in this and with his yard amongst the winners, Jane Williams' 4-y-o gets the nod to build on his promising return. For Old Times Sake should be all the sharper for his return so he can be the one to provide most resistance, with recent-winner Wispit Twob completing the shortlist with Bowen retaining the partnership. NO BOUNDARIES (FR) FOR OLD TIMES SAKE (IRE) WISPIT TWOB (IRE)

races.title: Welsh Cottage Christmas Cakes Handicap Chase
races.verdict: SEASETT shaped encouragingly on first start for new connections when runner-up at Hexham in late-August (had breathing operation) and given another try over the larger obstacles, Mickey Bowen's 8-y-o could well be the answer. He gets the nod over Pooroldmackley , who was in good form prior to his most recent effort so can get back on track. Unleash The Beast rounds off the shortlist on return/chasing debut. SEASETT POOROLDMACKLEY (IRE) UNLEASH THE BEAST (IRE)
